_about: Procurement vocabulary used for purchase_orders.description and contracts.scope_text. DEV/EVAL ONLY - src/ must never import this.
source_organization: Secretaria de la Funcion Publica / Secretaria Anticorrupcion y Buen Gobierno - CompraNet
what_was_used: Terminology and contract-shape vocabulary only: the naming conventions Mexican public and corporate procurement uses for framework agreements, milestone schedules and recurring services. NO CompraNet contract record, supplier name, or amount was copied, and no invented misconduct is attached to any CompraNet participant.
retrieval_limitation: The CompraNet open-data bulk download was not retrieved in this run. The vocabulary below reflects standard Mexican procurement phrasing and is used as format realism, not as a data extract.

contract_shapes.contrato_marco: Framework agreement with a fixed monthly fee and a stated term.
contract_shapes.contrato_abierto: Open contract with a minimum and maximum amount, drawn down by orders.
contract_shapes.servicio_recurrente: Recurring monthly service with a fixed fee.
contract_shapes.adquisicion: One-off acquisition of goods or equipment.
